summary: Coordinates the generation of project README files by defining document structures, managing build contexts, and organizing builder and renderer submodules.
responsibilities: Initializes the README build context, defines README document structures and rendering options, and coordinates file generation.
relationships: The readme generation module coordinates the build context, document definitions, and child packages for building and rendering README files.
design_decisions: Uses modular section builders and submodules for building, rendering, and internal file handling to generate project README files.
